capabilities: Browse images across the vault with automatically generated thumbnails
Search images by name and extension
Background-index the vault for instant search results
Limit indexing to a chosen image folder
Toggle gif animation in previews for performance
extras: Docs link points elsewhere; README covers settings and roadmap but no usage walkthrough. Planned features include local LLM image descriptions, metadata search, and video/audio support.
problem: Obsidian has no fast visual way to browse and search image files across a vault before embedding them.
summary: Image picker that background-indexes vault images, generates thumbnails, and lets you browse, search, and embed them quickly.
